name: application-quote-estimate-panel
title: Quote Estimate Panel
description: Coverage/deductible/term sliders driving a live estimated premium and rate breakdown, recomputed in real time from slider state.
useWhen: Letting a shopper explore how coverage amount, deductible, and term trade off against estimated premium before requesting a full quote.
You want immediate, continuous feedback as inputs change rather than a submit-and-wait calculation.
A breakdown (base rate plus adjustments) helps the user understand why the premium moved, not just the final number.
avoidWhen: You need discrete text-entry fields (home price, down payment) for a one-time calculation — use `mortgage-calculator` for that form-field-driven pattern instead.
The real premium depends on underwriting factors that can't be approximated client-side — show a static disclaimer instead of implying real-time accuracy.
Only a single input drives the output — a simpler single-slider control is enough.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-md) that stacks sliders vertically at all widths; the breakdown row wraps rather than overflowing at narrow widths.
accessibility: Every slider has a visible <label> tied via htmlFor/id, plus a live-updating value readout next to the label.
The premium and its full breakdown are derived from the same three slider values on every change, so they can never disagree.
The static HTML fixture's initial numbers match what the live calculation produces for its default slider positions, so no-JS viewers see accurate values.

variants.title: Quote Estimate Panel
